description: Full-stack web language and framework for AI agents. .art files hold the pages, components, data models and api of one program, and compile to dependency-free JavaScript and a Node server.
rules: Expressions are JavaScript; only the structure (page, component, model, api, state, computed, data, fn and the view) is ArtScript's own.
Every .art file in src/ is part of one program: there are no imports between .art files.
After every change run npx art check --ai and apply what it reports: each error has expected, actual and fixes.
Write data, constants, helpers and formatting in .art. Use a .ts file only for code that drives the DOM or a canvas, runs heavy loops, or wraps a library that owns its DOM.
